I’m Nikita, an Indian Physiotherapist in London, UK (aka The United Kingdom). I have completed my MSc in Physiotherapy from University College London and am working as a Band 6 Physiotherapist in NHS. On this channel I will discuss topics related to HCPC, CSP, working in NHS, UK Visa Application, Expenses and Budgeting, Life in the UK, Studying in UK, UK Universities, and how to adjust to living in the UK as a new international Healthcare Profession/Student! 

Through this channel, I hope to help international graduates understand the many ways they can get their registration and work as Healthcare Professionals in the UK.

If you would like to contact me, find me at https://www.physiotherapyinuk.com/
